scope: Composed JavaScript race with original physics, AI, contacts, bonuses and timers. A test-only route follower supplies ordinary analog controls. No poses, velocities, triggers, pickups, timers, or physics tables are changed. This is not an original Windows full-process comparison or a full-campaign UI run.
railForecast: Copied NativePlayerMotion calls retain original prepare, eight collision/Euler/matrix/rail-response substeps, sector and wheel-ground update. Dynamic-body contact aborts private forecast without resolving or invoking callbacks.
startPolicy: Original authored opening camera and321 countdown. Ordinary throttle1/steer0 held until observed native green; route driver first invoked on following tick. No forced phase or timer changes.
testDriverPolicy: Exact audited closed ground chord path between original DMP nodes, applied from observed green. Fixed original road-node line with recorded turn penalty and nodes; look-ahead starts from projection onto the chosen lane segment rather than the road center; recorded later corner windows use private closed-loop scalar forecasts and ordinary steering/throttle/brake; detour planner disabled; production obstacles and collision responses remain active. Ordinary inputs only.
